text:
sam-partners: Quick sync 0 mins: we need structured inputs from hardware partners for the Q3 cost model: effective spot premium, minimum commit (months), refundability of onboarding/listing credits, fulfillment lag, and any geo locks.
sam-partners: attaching a template would help. Can @vendor-bot pull VegaCompute + Aurora feeds and include any notes on tranche releases / cliff behavior?
vendor-bot: Uploaded export (link) 0: includes sku, reserved_months, spot_premium_pct (30d median), onboarding_credit_usd, refundable_flag. Adding columns per ask: fulfillment_days, eviction_prob_pct (hourly avg), region_code.
lucy-finance: thanks. Clarify onboarding_credit_usd scope: is that a per-account rebate or per-sku coupon? We need to model both cases differently.
vendor-bot: Note: onboarding_credit_usd = per-account for enterprise-tier SKUs, per-sku for marketplace ephemeral SKUs. We'll add a "credit_scope" flag in the next export. Sample row: sku=vc-gpu-a2,reserved_months=12,spot_premium_pct=19,onboarding_credit_usd=3000,refundable_flag=false,credit_scope=account,fulfillment_days=7,eviction_prob_pct=0.6,region_code=us-west-2
omar-eng: From runtime side: if reserved_months < 6, our scheduler deprioritizes ephemeral supply and observed throughput variance increases ~12-25%. Can vendors provide tranche_release cadence (e.g., month0:40%, month2:60%)?
vendor-bot: Will include tranche_release as CSV-friendly string: "0:40,60:60" meaning 40% immediate, 60% after 60 days.
nina-ops: Also flag allow_burst and suggested burst_markup_pct for transient bursts. If allow_burst=false we must route to other regions; add region_lock boolean.
vendor-bot: Added fields allow_burst (true/false), burst_markup_pct, region_lock (true/false), payment_terms (e.g., net30/net60). Some partners defer marketplace listing fees until close (net60) which alters short-window cost.
zach-sales: Can partners also supply a 12-quarter blended_cost_usd for reserved SKUs so finance can use an effective blended unit cost rather than raw list price?
lucy-finance: yes please. Also flag any minimum_monthly_commit_usd (commit floors) 0. That determines reserved vs dedicated classification for our revenue recognition.
vendor-bot: Added blended_cost_usd_12q and minimum_monthly_commit_usd. Also providing eviction_distribution_sample: "0-6h:0.4%,6-24h:0.8%,24-72h:0.3%" (example).
sam-partners: Outstanding 0. Followups: 1) Include legal_ref_link for refundable onboarding credits (lucy) 2) Mark whether SKUs participate in partner rebate programs (boolean) 3) Provide historical utilization_pct for last 12 months if possible (helps forecasting).
vendor-bot: Will ask partners for utilization_12mo_pct (monthly delimited), legal_ref_link, partner_rebate_flag. Expect updated CSV in ~2 hours.
omar-eng: Once we have tranche_release + eviction distribution I'll run a quick Monte Carlo to show impact on tail-cost and latency and post results here. If folks want specific sensitivity, test spot_premium +/- 5ppt and tranche delays +/- 14 days.
lucy-finance: Also request that partners indicate whether blended_cost_usd_12q includes marketplace fees or excludes them. We'll need both views.
sam-partners: Great catch. I'll send the precise CSV schema to partners and chase any ambiguous entries. Goal: close this collection by EOD so modeling can run overnight. :rocket:
zach-sales: If some partners refuse to share blended cost, flag them so sales can follow up with commercial terms.
vendor-bot: Export queued. Will post link + checksum when ready. :white_check_mark:
